description: Source code for PduR routing functions in an AUTOSAR platform, handling transmission, reception indication, confirmation, and buffer provision for different communication modules.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_RouteTransmit
methods.description: Routes PDU transmission to the appropriate module based on destination module ID.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_RouteRxIndication
methods.description: Handles reception indication and forwards it to the correct module.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_RouteTxConfirmation
methods.description: Handles transmission confirmation and forwards it to the source module.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_RouteTriggerTransmit
methods.description: Triggers transmission for a route, calling the appropriate module's function.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_RouteProvideRxBuffer
methods.description: Provides receive buffer for DCM module.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_RouteProvideTxBuffer
methods.description: Provides transmit buffer for DCM module.
